claims: PlayStation Portal remote player costs $199.99-$249.99.
PlayStation Portal remote player is a handheld device designed to stream games from PS5 console over Wi-Fi.
PlayStation Portal remote player features an 8-inch LCD screen.
PlayStation Portal remote player has DualSense controller capabilities.
Popular Mechanics noted that PlayStation Portal remote player allows remote gameplay of installed PS4/PS5 titles.
Recent updates enable standalone cloud streaming via PS Plus Premium on PlayStation Portal remote player.
PlayStation Portal remote player's Remote Play streams games directly from PS5.
PlayStation Portal remote player's Remote Play allows playing in a different room or over public Wi-Fi.
PlayStation Portal remote player includes haptic feedback and adaptive triggers for supported games.
PlayStation Portal remote player's display is an 8-inch LCD screen capable of 1080p resolution at 60fps.
PlayStation Portal remote player's cloud streaming allows playing games without a PS5 console if you have a PS Plus Premium subscription.
PlayStation Portal remote player supports wired 3.5mm audio.
PlayStation Portal remote player supports PlayStation Link for wireless earbuds.
PlayStation Portal remote player requires high-speed internet of at least 5Mbps.
15Mbps is recommended for a better experience with PlayStation Portal remote player.
PlayStation Portal remote player requires a PS5 connected to a home broadband network.
PlayStation Portal remote player does not play games natively without streaming.
PlayStation Portal remote player cannot run native apps or media.
PlayStation Portal remote player's battery life is similar to the DualSense controller.
DualSense controller battery life is approximately 4–8 hours depending on usage.
For optimal performance, the PS5 should be connected to the internet via a wired LAN cable.
PlayStation Direct lists PlayStation Portal as a specialized device to enhance remote, mobile gaming for PS5 owners.
